sources.snippet: The color contrast is more aggressive. Some keywords will be drawn out, and it's almost impossible to correct and randomize. Eps is the opposite. In short, vpred is one step higher than eps. The eps model is simpler and easier to draw, and there are surprises in randomness. The vpred model will have surprises if you write keywords carefully.
